# Obsidian Ridge Labs

> Apps that mind their own business.

Obsidian Ridge Labs is an independent software studio in Las Vegas, Nevada. Echo Chamber is available on the App Store. The collection also includes apps in development; each product page shows its current availability.

- [Full content directory](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/llms-full.txt): Product descriptions, availability, FAQs, journal articles, and help guides.
- [The collection](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/download): Find an app by its job, requirements, and release status.
- [The Obsidian Ridge Labs standard](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/philosophy): The studio's principles and the Boundary Check.
- [Privacy model](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/privacy): Processing, storage defaults, and connected services.
- [Help center](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/help): Setup, features, and troubleshooting. Guides for unreleased apps are preview documentation.

## Products

- [ECHO CHAMBER](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/echochamber): Available on the App Store. Record or import a conversation, find a passage in its transcript, and make notes with processing on your device. Free to download with optional Pro; the current App Store and in-app purchase screen show the offer.
- [METTLE](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/mettle): In development. Logged sets guide the next reps and weight. Open “Why this?” to inspect the progression rule and evidence. iPhone, iOS 26.1, Apple Intelligence required; private iCloud storage is the default when available, with a local fallback.
- [MEMORA](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/memora): In development. Turn notes, photos, and PDFs with selectable text into draft flashcards. Choose which to add, edit saved cards, and study with FSRS. Local iPhone storage; content exports exclude review history and schedules.
- [VAULT](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/vault): In development. Check a purchase against recorded income, spending, and obligations. Manual entry and imports work without linking a bank. Optional connected banking and enrichment use Plaid and a relay. iOS 26 and Apple Intelligence required.
- [MOLEHILL](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/molehill): In development. Break down a task, then split a stuck step again. Editable brain dumps, one-step focus, and progress tracking run on iPhone. Pro adds Reminders and Calendar export.
- [COVE](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/cove): In development. Ask about past journal entries and return to the writing behind the answer. Reflection and search run on-device; private iCloud storage is used when available, with a local fallback.
- [KITH](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/kith): In development. Keep remembered details, prepare a message, and log a conversation when you return. You decide what to send. Local iPhone records and on-device assistance; no app-managed cloud sync in the current build.
- [MISE](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/mise): In development. Save recipes, plan meals, combine ingredients into a shopping list, and cook with readable steps and timers. Recipe pages and images are fetched directly; assistance runs locally. Optional Plus iCloud sync is off by default.
- [TROVE](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/trove): In development. Keep item photos, receipts, serial numbers, and warranties together. Free archives include available photos; Plus adds reports and optional iCloud record sync. Record sync is not a complete image backup.
- [WOVE](https://obsidianridgelabs.com/apps/wove): In development. Find outfits in your own clothes and give the stylist personal constraints. Plus adds wear-derived personalization and capsules. Trip packing uses a generic checklist. WeatherKit and optional Plus iCloud records are separate connections.

## The Boundary Check

Before trusting an app with personal material, ask where processing happens, where records are stored, and what connects to the network. On-device AI does not by itself mean every record is confined to one device. Cloud sync, purchases, model setup, connected services, and chosen exports have separate paths.

The product pages distinguish shipped availability from development previews. Current source features do not by themselves verify a public release. Echo Chamber's device compatibility, local models, allowances, and purchase options should be checked in its current App Store listing and installed app.

This website uses Google Analytics; it does not receive the content in the apps. See the privacy model for website measurement.
